title: Pointed finite Galois torsors descend along affine inverse limits
statement: Let I be a small cofiltered category and D,K:I→Scheme inverse systems with qcqs objects and affine transition maps. Let κ:X→D and b:T→K be limit cones. Let s:K→D be a natural transformation and sη:T→X a morphism with sηκ_i=b_i s_i for every i. Let G be a finite group and Z→X a finite étale G-torsor, not necessarily connected. Suppose there exists z:T→Z with zπ=sη. Then at some stage i there are a finite étale G-torsor Z_i→D_i and χ:Z→Z_i such that the square with the two torsor projections and κ_i is cartesian, and a morphism z_i:K_i→Z_i with z_iπ_i=s_i. No Noetherian, integral, normal or smooth hypothesis is assumed on these systems.

proof.text: Descend the unpointed torsor using [lem-sbc-galois-cover-stage-descent], giving i, Z₀, χ and hχ.

Choose the given point z and form P=Z₀.P×Dᵢ Kᵢ. The maps z≫χ and bᵢ have equal composites to Dᵢ by hχ.w, zπ=sη, and the compatibility hs. Their pullback lift a:T→P satisfies a≫p=bᵢ. The map p:P→Kᵢ is locally finitely presented because it is the base change of the étale map Z₀.π. Apply [lem-sbc-pointed-section-stage-descent] to get a refinement f:j→i and a₀:Kⱼ→P with a₀≫p=K.map f.

Use [lem-sbc-galois-cover-base-change] to pull Z₀ back to Dⱼ. Naturality of s and the projection equality for a₀ say (a₀≫pullback.fst)≫Z₀.π=sⱼ≫D.map f. Lift this pair into the new cover to obtain z₁ with z₁≫Z₁.π=sⱼ. Cone naturality gives κⱼ≫D.map f=κᵢ; hence χ and Z.π≫κⱼ lift to ψ:Z.P→Z₁.P. IsPullback.of_right' applied to the original comparison and the base-change square proves that ψ is cartesian over κⱼ. These data give the unchanged conclusion.

proof_origin.note: The limit-reduction route is unchanged; finite torsor descent is separated from proved section descent and proved base change.

theorem GaloisCover.exists_pointed_stage_of_affine_limits
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D K : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (hDqc : ∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)) (hDqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i))
    (hKqc : ∀ i, CompactSpace (K.obj i)) (hKqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (K.obj i))
    (hDa : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f))
    (hKa : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (K.map f))
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (κ : (Functor.const I).obj X ⟶ D)
    (b : (Functor.const I).obj T ⟶ K)
    (hκ : IsLimit (Cone.mk X κ)) (hb : IsLimit (Cone.mk T b))
    (s : K ⟶ D) (sη : T ⟶ X) (hs : ∀ i, sη ≫ κ.app i = b.app i ≫ s.app i)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (Z : GaloisCover G X)
    (hZ : ∃ z : T ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Z₀ : GaloisCover G (D.obj i)) (χ : Z.P ⟶ Z₀.P),
      IsPullback χ Z.π Z₀.π (κ.app i) ∧
      ∃ z₀ : K.obj i ⟶ Z₀.P, z₀ ≫ Z₀.π = s.app i
